data.name: Fareh
data.gender_notes: Fareh is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Fareh is of Arabic origin and means 'rare' or 'precious'. In Islamic history, it was used for a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) known for his wisdom and generosity. The name Fareh carries the meaning “Rare, precious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fareh usually hope their child will grow to embody rare, precious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to cherish and value the rare blessings in life.
data.etymology: Fareh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rare, precious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fareh total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: فارح
in_arabic.long_meaning: فارح هو اسم عربي يعني الفرح والسرور، وهو مشتق من الجذر العربي فرح، والذي يعني السعادة والابتهاج، وهو اسم شائع في الثقافة الإسلامية ويحمل دلالة إيجابية في القرآن الكريم

in_urdu.name: فارح
in_urdu.long_meaning: فارح ایک عربی نام ہے جو خوشی اور مسرت کا معنی رکھتا ہے، یہ نام عربي gốc فرح سے ماخوذ ہے، جو خوشی اور سرور کا معنی دیتا ہے، یہ نام برصغیر پاک و ہند میں بھی مسلمانوں میں مقبول ہے

in_hindi.name: फ़ारेह

in_pashto.name: فارح

Its unique spelling and Arabic origin give it an exotic appeal and can make it stand out among common names. data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Fareh stems from its origin in Islamic history, where it was used for a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). Abu Maryam al-Fihri, also known as Fareh, was a companion who possessed immense wisdom and generosity. As a devout Muslim, he was known for his piety and dedication to Islam. The name Fareh carries a deep spiritual meaning, reminding us of the importance of wisdom, generosity, and piety in our own lives. Abdul-Farid Hijazi, a famous Sufi poet, also bears this name, further emphasizing the spiritual significance of this name.
